verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia/Inso CLI supports `inso lint spec` to lint OpenAPI specs and fail CI builds on errors, directly supporting spec linting for platform engineers (kong-docs-13). However, there is no evidence of configurable style/governance rule sets (e.g., custom rulesets, org-wide governance policies) beyond basic OpenAPI validation. missing for 10: evidence of configurable linting rulesets, custom governance rule definitions, or org-level rule enforcement beyond pass/fail on spec validity.
